topSlice.title: Member dashboard home issues 20+ Prisma reads plus Coursera sync
topSlice.blast: app/(portal)/dashboard/page.tsx is 1369 lines and calls prisma ~24 times plus getMemberState (Redis 300s), loadMemberCareerBriefBundleSafe, maybeAutoSyncCourseraOnDashboard, fetchLearnerProgressFromB4B, getPortalSwitcherRoles (up to 6 lookups when not precomputed). Same request already paid layout GUC bootstrap. Under many concurrent members this is the path that previously 504'd (lib/db/prisma.ts:88-94 ~10 queries on portal entry). getMemberState cache is no-op without Upstash.
topSlice.evidence: rg prisma. app/(portal)/dashboard/page.tsx → 24 matches (lines 164-957). Additional awaits: ensureAppUserProvisioned, getMemberState, maybeAutoSyncCourseraOnDashboard, fetchLearnerProgressFromB4B, loadSkillMissionSummary. lib/auth/portalRoleSwitcher.ts:110-132 fetchPortalSwitcherInputs Promise.all of isSuperAdmin, getUserRoles, then 4 more lookups. lib/member/getMemberState.ts:419 getCacheOrFetch 300s — lib/cache.ts:28-29 returns null without Redis.

topSlice.title: Root layout and middleware hit Supabase + Prisma on every HTML request
topSlice.blast: Anonymous marketing/apply/enroll SSR: middleware always createServerClient + getSession (middleware.ts:263-304). Layout then getUser() when x-wap-user-id is absent (app/layout.tsx:135), resolveOrgFromRequest → getDefaultOrganizationId (first miss per isolate), getRequestOrgBranding, getMessages (loads 184KB messages/en.json). Authenticated portal adds getProfileRole + user.findUnique inside $transaction + ensureAppUserProvisioned. This is the 2026-06-30 / portal-504 shape: pooler saturation before page queries start. More orgs/users do not change the per-request tax; more traffic does.
topSlice.evidence: middleware.ts:300-304 getSession on non-protected paths; :290-295 getUser on portal/admin. app/layout.tsx:135 forwardedUserId ?? getUser(). app/layout.tsx:210 resolveOrgFromRequest. app/layout.tsx:214 getRequestOrgBranding. i18n/request.ts:40 import messages/en.json (184184 bytes). lib/tenant/organization.ts:9-13 process-local cachedDefaultOrgId only — each serverless isolate pays one org findUnique. customDomainCache is a process Map (lib/tenant/customDomainCache.ts:26) so Edge/Node isolates miss independently.
topSlice.verify: rg -n 'await getUser\(\)' app/layout.tsx && rg -n 'getSession\(\)' middleware.ts && wc -c messages/en.json

topSlice.title: Unauthenticated WIOA voice session mints ElevenLabs URLs with fail-open limiter
topSlice.blast: POST /api/public/wioa-qualification/voice-session has no getUser. It rate-limits via checkPublicVoiceSessionRateLimit which returns {success:true} when Upstash is null (lib/rate-limit.ts:524-527). File prices voice at ~$0.30/min and 1k unbounded reqs ≈ $1.5-3k. This is not on TENANT_API_PATHS. First beat covered apply/AI/voice fail-open for authed tools; it missed the public no-account mint. CI and Vercel build set RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_MISSING_UPSTASH=1 so preview deploys run this open.
topSlice.evidence: app/api/public/wioa-qualification/voice-session/route.ts:22-55 POST, no getUser, startElevenLabsPortalSession('wioa_prequal'). lib/rate-limit.ts:86-88 cost comment; :524-527 fail-open. middleware.ts:75 TENANT_API_PATHS omits /api/public and /api/ai. .github/workflows/ci-gate.yml:32 RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_MISSING_UPSTASH=1.
topSlice.verify: rg -n 'getUser' app/api/public/wioa-qualification/voice-session/route.ts; test $? -ne 0 && rg -n 'if \(!publicVoiceSessionRateLimiter\) return \{ success: true \}' lib/rate-limit.ts

topSlice.title: withTenantScope is a no-op for PlacementRecord, CourseProgress, Application, messages
topSlice.blast: makeScopedProxy returns the raw delegate when the model is not in TENANT_SCOPED_MODELS. WIOA report wraps placementRecord.count/aggregate and courseProgress.groupBy and user.findMany take:10000 inside withTenantScope and treats that as isolation. PlacementRecord and CourseProgress have no organizationId column (schema.prisma Application:384, PlacementRecord:1255, CourseProgress:1851). A second-org admin hitting a 'scoped' API still reads every placement/progress row. verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs asserts withTenantScope is called; it does not assert the model is in the set.
topSlice.evidence: lib/tenant/scopeProxy.ts:45-60 TENANT_SCOPED_MODELS (user/partner/employer/job/course/courseEnrollment/catalog/screening/chapter*). :96-98 if !TENANT_SCOPED_MODELS.has(prop) return Reflect.get — pass-through. app/api/admin/reports/wioa/route.ts:26-56 withTenantScope then db.placementRecord / db.courseProgress / db.user.findMany take:10000. prisma/schema.prisma PlacementRecord has no organizationId. scripts/verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs does not mention training-progress, placements/page, members/page, counselors.

topSlice.title: Admin layout is global isAdmin(); many admin pages query all tenants
topSlice.blast: isAdmin() does not check organizationId (lib/auth/roles.ts:40-45). app/admin/layout.tsx:35 gates on isAdmin only. Pages such as training-progress, placements, students, users, overview call prisma.*.findMany with no withTenantScope / organizationId. A second-org admin who is isAdmin() reads every member/placement/progress row. Partner pages were scoped after run_20260816; the rest of /admin was not.
topSlice.evidence: app/admin/layout.tsx:35 isAdmin(user.id). app/admin/training-progress/page.tsx:42 isAdmin then :56-78 prisma.user.findMany take 5000, courseEnrollment take 5000, courseProgress take 20000 — no organizationId. app/admin/placements/page.tsx:64 isAdmin then :69 prisma.placementRecord.findMany take 500 no org filter. rg withTenantScope app/admin/training-progress app/admin/placements → no matches. isAdminInOrg exists at lib/auth/roles.ts:57-65 and is unused by these pages.

topSlice.title: Apply signup always writes users/applications into getDefaultOrganizationId()
topSlice.blast: Sibling of clm_secrets_orphan_user_default_org (healer). The conversion path itself never consults resolveOrgFromRequest / custom-domain x-wap-org-id. app/api/apply/signup/route.ts:367 organizationId = getDefaultOrganizationId() then user + application + profile creates use that id. A custom-domain school funnel still stamps workforceap. First beat mapped only the healer; this is the write that creates the row the healer later 'heals'. Tests mock getDefaultOrganizationId and never assert request-org.
topSlice.evidence: app/api/apply/signup/route.ts:13 import getDefaultOrganizationId; :367 const organizationId = await withDbRetry(() => getDefaultOrganizationId()); :406,:437,:575 create payloads include that organizationId. No resolveOrgFromRequest in the file. app/api/apply/signup/route.test.ts mocks getDefaultOrganizationId → org-test-1.

topSlice.title: GDPR delete anonymizes users/profiles but leaves resume blobs and messages
topSlice.blast: POST /api/gdpr/delete re-auths with password, signOut, raw UPDATE users email/name, UPDATE profiles nulls PII columns, inserts member_events, deletes Supabase auth user. It does not remove member-resumes / member-files objects (upload routes write cert-files/${userId}/ and resume paths). It does not delete or anonymize messages, applications.notes, placement_surveys, webhook payloads, or xapi_statements. Export (buildMemberExport) returns those tables — delete does not. lib/gdpr/ has no storage cleanup. Resume path columns are nulled so the app loses the pointer; the bucket object remains.
topSlice.evidence: app/api/gdpr/delete/route.ts:75-119 raw SQL users+profiles+member_events only. rg storage|resume_original|member-resumes lib/gdpr → no matches. app/api/member/resume/upload/route.ts:48 uploads to BUCKET. app/api/member/certifications/upload/route.ts:8 BUCKET=member-files path cert-files/${user.id}. lib/member/exportData.ts:23-63 still lists applications, messages, placements, surveys.
